name: crypte-verif
description: Verify Crypt: Rust build with 0 warning, fmt, clippy, tests, frontend types, vitest and build. Run from the repository root.

steps.prompt: In this Tauri v2 + Svelte 5 repository (Rust in `src-tauri/`), run from the repository root: `cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check`, then `cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`. Fix the warnings and the formatting if needed. End with send_message severity success summarising: remaining warnings (0 expected) and the fmt result. Answer in English.
